answer: Under convex reputation, each key keeps an orchard: a non-transferable ledger of credit grown only from its own graded work, and vote weight is that credit squared. An operator holding credit C who splits it over n clones gets n(C/n)^2 = C^2/n, so every extra head shrinks total sway, and growing n orchards separately costs full graded work n times. New keys stay violet, earning half credit, until an unannounced zephyr audit re-grades a random sample of their answers. The weak spot is a patient farm grinding for months, so idle credit slowly decays.
